references.title: Deriving the intrinsic viability constraint of an emergent individual from first principles
references.author: Beer, Randall D. and McShaffrey, Connor and Gaul, Thomas M.
references.note: Intrinsic viability constraint. Cited by autopoiesis for the viability-bound reading of closure: viability bounds are constraints on a shared state that must be maintained for a composition to persist; crossing the bound (breaking the boundary so nothing is enclosed) shuts off the closure-gated maintenance that keeps the composition alive.
